text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both modestly positive, with ETH outpacing BTC's gains, suggesting some allocation rotation toward alternative assets despite elevated uncertainty. The Fear & Greed index at 48 (neutral, declining) reflects caution—neither panic nor euphoria—while BTC dominance holding steady at 59.4% indicates the market isn't fleeing to altcoins yet. Total volume of $62B is moderate, consistent with a consolidation phase where participants are watching rather than committing aggressively in either direction.
